en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl BiN Shazaan, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al Waleed Bin Sabeeh, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘But rather, the body is built upon the bread’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Ibrahim ibn ‘ Abd al-Hamid from al-Walid ibn Sabih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The body is built on bread only.’”
